description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Regulations under Section 4 of the Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No. 17 of 2010
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No. 17 of 2010. It establishes legal and regulatory frameworks for casino business licensing, including application procedures, evaluation criteria, license fees, and cancellation procedures. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
